description: You commune with nature spirits and gain knowledge of the surrounding area. Outdoors, the spell gives you knowledge within 3 miles. In caves and other natural underground settings, the radius is 300 feet. The spell doesn't function where nature has been replaced by construction. Choose three of the following facts: settlements; portals to other planes; one CR 10+ creature that is a Celestial, Elemental, Fey, Fiend, or Undead; the prevalent kind of plant, mineral, or Beast; locations of bodies of water.
name: Commune with Nature
